Each identity's action timing, phrasing habits, and tool-call sequences are hashed into a style vector; identities whose vectors cluster tightly beyond a chance threshold are flagged and their shared payout frozen pending review. Like a quill leaving the same slant, sock puppets betray shared authorship. The falcon sweep re-clusters weekly, so rotation is expensive. A prism separates each agent's signal across sessions; evasion demands distinct behavioral profiles per identity, raising attacker cost to sustained manual operation per account.
